questions.prompt: Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs. Construct a line through P tangent to the circle with center O.
questions.prompt_markup:
Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs.

questions.correct_answer: Draw OP; construct its midpoint M (perpendicular bisector); draw the circle with center M through O; it meets circle O at T₁ and T₂; draw PT₁ (and PT₂).
questions.grading_note: Grade the construction marks, not only the final figure: segment OP, the perpendicular bisector arcs locating M, the circle on diameter OP, and the tangent through a crossing point T.

questions.prompt: Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs. Construct a line through R tangent to the circle with center O. Then write one sentence explaining why your line is tangent.

Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs.
